model: OML-PPO Appendix B reflection-only, equal-input-power blackbody model
assumptions: Effective emission = 1 - view_factor^2 * R; film absorption/re-emission is not modeled.
Eye-weighted visible integral: 400-780 nm; training score/weights/bounds are not inputs.
Default two emitting faces is an inferred normalization, not a specified paper geometry.
Outside the optical window, R is constant at outside_reflectance (default 0); no nk extrapolation.

H. Wang et al. Automated multi-layer optical design via deep reinforcement learning. Machine Learning: Science and Technology 2 (2021), 025013. https://doi.org/10.1088/2632-2153/abc327

material_datasets.comments: Converted from OML-PPO data/Al2O3.csv; commit ef63afe85e9c09cb3ccf0df01218c6264535ac9c. Original wavelength unit: um; YAML unit: micrometre. Original numeric samples retained, with no new resampling or extrapolation. Source CSV may contain constant extensions or sparse sampling already added upstream; its numeric coverage is not proof of measured physical validity. Repository training code uses quadratic interpolation; film_hppo currently uses linear interpolation. Not an official refractiveindex.info dataset; underlying experimental provenance is not inferred.
